campaign: Native DPO vertical: recipe authority, bounded scoring, direct gradients, exact resume
doctrine: Follow skill.md. Implement one complete offline preference-training path before adding rollout methods. Active recipes and typed artifacts own policy. Reuse trainingdata, trainingprogram, hostmath, optimizer, checkpoint, and runrecord. Retain no full sequence-by-vocabulary logits. Add no family switches, wrappers, fallbacks, environment policy, implicit defaults, or parallel orchestration. Each step migrates its consumer immediately and has a failable verifier.

items.title: Compute selected token log probabilities and VJPs without retained logits

steps.title: Add destination-based tiled projection log-sum-exp and backward primitives with extents derived from validated bindings
steps.rationale: Preference training needs only selected token likelihoods. Recompute bounded projection tiles during VJP instead of retaining logits.

items.title: Compile and evaluate the DPO objective

steps.title: Add stable DPO loss and score gradients over policy/reference chosen/rejected sequence log probabilities
steps.rationale: Keep objective math independent of model execution and require explicit reference scores and scale.

items.title: Batch deterministic preference pairs with exact shared prefixes

steps.title: Compile chosen/rejected token pairs from trainingdata examples, preserve source identity, derive exact common prefixes, and resume by stream identity and position
steps.rationale: Prefix sharing is valid only for exact token equality. Existing deterministic stream state remains the sole sampler checkpoint.

items.title: Route one dense-causal training consumer through the compiled DPO path

steps.title: Score policy/reference once per pair, backpropagate weighted selected-token likelihoods into optimizer-owned gradients, update once, and retain no full logits
steps.rationale: The vertical is complete only when a production model capability consumes the shared authority and math without an advisory path beside it.

items.title: Prove exact DPO resume and publish typed run evidence

steps.title: Bind DPO authority to checkpoints and run records; prove interrupted execution matches uninterrupted weights, optimizer state, stream position, and objective metrics
steps.rationale: Completion requires reproducible state and evidence, not only local loss movement.
